decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to assemble the combo of Lotus Field with various mana ramp, untap, and search effects in order to generate a large amount of mana quickly. The deck uses cards like Sylvan Scrying, Vizier of Tumbling Sands, Hidden Strings, and Bala Ged Recovery to find and untap Lotus Field, allowing for explosive plays. The deck also includes cards like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum for additional win conditions or to tutor up key pieces. Overall, the deck aims to create a powerful mana engine to overpower opponents.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deploy Arclight Phoenixes by casting cheap spells, utilizing cards like Opt, Fiery Impulse, and Lightning Axe to trigger their revival ability. The deck also includes card draw options like Treasure Cruise and Consider to maintain card advantage. Additionally, disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Ashiok, Dream Render help to disrupt opponents' game plans. The deck aims to be aggressive and proactive, applying pressure through flyers like Arclight Phoenix while also disrupting opponents' strategies.

This deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. It uses cheap spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse to trigger the Phoenix's ability, and card draw spells like Treasure Cruise to refill the hand. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Brazen Borrower to control the opponent's game plan. Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional threats to close out the game swiftly. Overall, the deck focuses on aggressive graveyard recursion and tempo plays to overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using green devotion creatures and lands like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, in order to cast powerful green spells like Storm the Festival and Elder Gargaroth early on. This aggressive strategy is supported by cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Oath of Nissa and Boseiju, Who Endures helps to ensure consistency in drawing key cards and protecting important spells from counter magic.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifact creatures and equipment to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. Ensoul Artifact can turn any artifact into a powerful creature, while cards like Spyglass Siren and Smuggler's Copter provide additional threats and utility. Shrapnel Blast and Torch the Tower offer removal options and reach to finish off opponents. With a focus on speed and power, this deck aims to establish a dominant board presence early on and pressure the opponent into submission.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's resources while generating value through discard effects and card advantage. By using cards like Thoughtseize, Duress, and Go Blank to strip away the opponent's key cards, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with threats, the deck aims to grind out a victory. Cards like Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide powerful late-game threats to close out the game. The deck also utilizes cards like Waste Not and Castle Locthwain for additional value and card advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and burn spells to deal quick and consistent damage. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Ghitu Lavarunner, along with burn spells like Play with Fire and Skewer the Critics, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. With cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Kumano Faces Kakkazan providing additional damage output, the deck seeks to end the game swiftly before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds a unique twist to the deck's strategy.

This deck focuses on using a variety of low-cost creatures and spells to quickly pressure the opponent and control the board through disruption and tempo plays. The key strategy is to efficiently deploy Spirit creatures and use disruptive spells like Spell Queller and Spell Pierce to keep the opponent off balance while maintaining pressure. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays while leveraging the tribal synergies of Spirits to create a fast-paced and powerful aggro strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up your mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Wolfwillow Haven, and then utilize Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to generate a large amount of green mana. This will allow you to play powerful green creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns, while also benefiting from Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner's card draw ability. The deck also includes cards like Storm the Festival and Outcaster Trailblazer to maintain pressure on your opponent and finish them off with big creatures like Lair of the Hydra and Ulvenwald Oddity.

This deck focuses on casting multiple spells per turn to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and deal damage quickly to the opponent. It includes cards that allow for card selection and draw, as well as removal spells to control the board. The deck also utilizes the prowess ability of some creatures to further increase its aggro potential. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise helps refill the hand with resources, ensuring a steady stream of spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix and pressure the opponent. The mana base is optimized for casting spells efficiently.

Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy by using cards like Thoughtseize, Duress, and Liliana of the Veil to strip away their resources. It also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with threats on the board. The deck aims to control the game using cards like Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal, Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, and Reckoner Bankbuster to maintain dominance. The mana base includes utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Field of Ruin to support the strategy. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent through careful resource management.

This red aggro deck focuses on dealing fast, direct damage to the opponent while maintaining board control with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage. Utilizing burn spells like Skewer the Critics and Wizard's Lightning, along with efficient creatures like Ghitu Lavarunner, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The inclusion of Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear provides additional reach and late-game threats. Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance offer additional removal options, while Monstrous Rage and Light Up the Stage provide card advantage and additional damage potential.

A fast-paced Rakdos Aggro deck focused on aggressive creatures and disruption spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing cards like Preacher of the Schism, Bloodtithe Harvester, and Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord to put pressure on the opponent while Thoughtseize and Fatal Push disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet to seal the game. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal spells, and disruption, this deck aims to win the game through relentless aggression.

The focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of removal spells, counter spells, and powerful creatures. By using cards like Leyline Binding and Vanishing Verse to deal with threats, as well as Niv-Mizzet Reborn to generate card advantage, the deck aims to outvalue opponents while disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of Bring to Light allows for flexibility in finding key cards, while the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value through blinking permanents. Overall, the deck excels at maintaining board control and outlasting opponents in longer games.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly cast spells to return Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard to the battlefield, creating a fast and aggressive playstyle. The deck includes cards like Lightning Axe, Opt, and Treasure Cruise to enable this strategy, while also including disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Picklock Prankster to control the game. The addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra element of versatility to the deck. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of creatures and spells for a powerful aggro strategy.

This deck focuses on using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful value engine, with a diverse array of multicolored cards to optimize his ability. The deck includes a mix of removal spells, ramp cards, and powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation. The inclusion of cards like Bring to Light allows for flexibility in finding the right answer for any situation. With a solid mana base and access to a wide range of powerful spells, this deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent through card advantage and powerful threats.
